candidates.statement: Gateway checkout returns 502 because the order service returns 502, which traces show originates from payment returning 503 on POST /v1/authorizations; the payment dependency is failing with server errors, propagating 502 up through order to gateway checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side telemetry (logs/metrics) not collected; root fault within payment unconfirmed. Inventory/redis path succeeded.

report.explanation: Traces across three correlation IDs consistently show payment returning 503 on /v1/authorizations, order returning 502, and gateway checkout returning 502. Gateway logs and metrics confirm 502s on /v1/checkout and client 502s to order. Topology confirms gateway->order->payment. Payment-side evidence is missing, so the bounded candidate is upstream server-error propagation.
